title: 第七章 融成一体第八章 不想忍了
slug: 入梦撩拨我成了兽校顶级万人迷
content_zh:
接下来几天，风奕一直没有出现。
月翎的耐心告罄，她知道自己该选择新目标了。
当初选定风奕，实在是因为他太过出名。
ss级的精神力、显赫的家世，还有那张拒人千里的英俊脸庞，都成了洛克郡学生茶余饭后的谈资。
至于那天她一时心软救下的雄性，等级太低，无法帮她提升精神力。
越级安抚这事见不得光，所以她没打算去冒领救命之恩。
如果将来这救命之恩有用处，再挑明不迟。
马上就到和母亲约定的日子，这几天她一边在实验室兼职，一边试图打听更多s级雄性的事情。
可她太过清贫，平时又低调过头，同学们见了她根本不主动靠近。
就在她思索怎么才能打听到有用讯息时，前面几道身影挡住了她前往实验室的路。
“听说前几天有雄性失控，不知道真的假的。”
“真的，我一个学姐亲眼看见的。”
月翎脚步微缓。
没有催促，只不紧不慢地走着，恰好与他们保持着能听清谈话、又不显得刻意的距离。
“听说是大家族的私生子，叫泽禹……”
“性格乖戾，但以前很受宠，咱们惹不起，以后见了他记得绕着走。”
月翎垂下眼，嘴角几不可察地动了动。
私生子，性格乖戾，惹不起。
她没有去领救命之恩看样子是正确的选择。
这些学生消息似乎挺灵通。

眼珠一转，故意快走几步追上他们的步伐，侧头看了他们一眼，脸上带着恰到好处的犹豫。
“你们在说那个失控的雄性吗？”
几个雌性一愣，随即点头。
月翎抿了抿唇，小声道：“我上次在东边花园见过他，当时可把我吓坏了！”
说着，还故意露出一副心有余悸的模样。
站在她身边的圆脸雌性立马好奇地瞪圆了眼珠，“发生什么事了？”
见鱼儿上钩，月翎压制住欢喜，“他失控了，像野兽一样直接就朝我冲了过来。”
几个雌性集体惊呼一声。
“我一直跑一直跑，可还是被他抓住……”
她的语调带着浓浓后怕，睫毛还恰到好处地颤了颤。
“然后呢？”
圆脸雌性继续追问，几个雌性也都不自觉地流露出紧张神色。
content_en:
Feng Yi never showed up in the next few days.
Yueling's patience ran out, and she knew it was time to choose a new goal.
I originally chose Feng Yi because he was too famous.
SS-level mental strength, prominent family background, and that handsome face that is unmatched by others have all become topics of conversation among Rock County students after dinner.
As for the male she saved in a moment of weakness that day, his level was too low to help her improve her mental power.
The matter of overstepping one's rank to appease someone was shady, so she had no intention of pretending to receive a life-saving favor.
If this life-saving grace is useful in the future, it is not too late to point it out.
The day agreed with her mother was coming soon. In the past few days, she was working part-time in the laboratory while trying to find out more about S-class males.
But she was too poor and kept a low profile, so her classmates didn't take the initiative to approach her when they saw her.
Just as she was thinking about how to get useful information, several figures in front blocked her way to the laboratory.
"I heard that a male lost control a few days ago. I don't know if it's true or not."
"Really, a senior sister of mine saw it with her own eyes."
Yue Ling's steps slowed down slightly.
There was no urging, he just walked slowly and at a distance that allowed him to hear the conversation clearly without seeming deliberate.
"I heard he is an illegitimate son from a big family, his name is Ze Yu..."
"He has a surly personality, but he was very favored in the past. We can't afford to offend him. Remember to walk around him when you see him in the future."
Yue Ling lowered her eyes and moved the corners of her mouth almost imperceptibly.
He is an illegitimate child with a surly personality and cannot be offended.
It seemed like she made the right choice by not accepting the life-saving grace.
These students seemed to be quite well informed.
He rolled his eyes, deliberately took a few steps to catch up with them, and glanced sideways at them, with just the right amount of hesitation on his face.
"Are you talking about the out-of-control male?"
Several females were stunned for a moment, then nodded.
Yue Ling pursed her lips and whispered: "I saw him last time in the East Garden, and he scared me at the time!"
As he spoke, he deliberately showed a lingering fear.
The round-faced female standing next to her immediately widened her eyes curiously, "What happened?"
Seeing the fish take the bait, Yue Ling suppressed her joy, "He lost control and rushed towards me like a wild beast."
Several females collectively exclaimed.
"I kept running and running, but he still caught me..."
Her tone was full of fear, and her eyelashes trembled just right.
"Then what?"
The round-faced female continued to ask, and several females unconsciously showed nervous expressions.
